dashboard.sessionExpired: Ikiringo cawe ntikwashoboye kwemezwa. Ndagusavye usubire winjire.

dashboard.notificationsPersonal: Raba imenyesha, itaba ubutumire bw'imigambi kandi uganire ku migambi mu buryo bw'ibanga.
dashboard.fullPersonalBody: Raba kandi uvugurure amakuru yabitswe igihe wari utangaza umugambi, harimwo itariki y'amavuko, amakuru yo kubarizamwo, ubwenegihugu, aho uba, ivyo ukunda n'amakuru y'ibanga y'ibanki.
dashboard.fullPersonalNote: Impinduka zibikwa mu fishi y'amakuru bwite ikoreshwa mu gutangaza imigambi. Ushobora kuvugurura izina rya mbere n'izina ry'umuryango mu fishi y'amakuru bwite. Impinduka z'imeyili yo kwinjira zicungwa ukwazo.
dashboard.organizationSavedNote: Aya ni amakuru y'ishirahamwe ryawe yabitswe. Guhindura umwirondoro w'ishirahamwe ntabiraboneka kuri uru rupapuro.
dashboard.myProjectsBody: Raba inyandiko z'agateganyo n'imigambi yatangajwe, harimwo iyahawe imfashanyo, iriko irakorwa, yarangiye kandi yafunzwe. Soma ibiri mu mugambi canke ukomeze guhindura inyandiko y'agateganyo.

dashboard.passwordSuccessSuffix: Koresha ijambo ry'ibanga rishasha mu gihe uzokwinjira.

dashboard.changeError: Ijambo ry'ibanga ryawe ntiryashoboye guhindurwa. Ndagusavye ugerageze ukundi.

projectWizard.intro: Kurikiza intambwe zisabwa. Umugambi wawe ugaragara ku mugaragaro gusa iyo uwusuzumye kandi wemeje ko utangazwa.
projectWizard.loadingDraft: Turiko turakura inyandiko y'agateganyo no kugarura amakuru yabitswe…
projectWizard.draftNote: Inyandiko z'agateganyo zibitswe ziraboneka mu Migambi yanje. Uburyo bwo gusoma umugambi buraboneka nyuma y'igenzura ry'umutekano n'itegurwa ry'amapapuro.
projectWizard.step1Body: Shira icifuzo cawe nka PDF. Inyandiko y'agateganyo y'umugambi iremwa nyuma yo gushira neza.
projectWizard.noExperts: Nta Expert yemewe iboneka ubu. Ukeneye ikonti y'Expert yemewe yindi mbere yo kurangiza iyi ntambwe.
projectWizard.step5Body: Bika amakuru yawe bwite. Iyo amakuru ayuzuye, urugendo rukomeza ibwarya ku gusuzuma no gutangaza umugambi.
projectWizard.step6Body: Fungura amakuru yawe yabitswe, ukosore ibisabwa, kandi ubike impinduka zawe imbere yo gutangaza. Ushobora gusuzuma no guhindura kenshi mu gihe umugambi ukiri inyandiko y'agateganyo.

projectWizard.postNotReady:
Umugambi wawe ntawatangajwe kuko icifuzo cawo kitari citeguye.

PDF yashizwe ikwiye kurangiza igenzura ry'umutekano n'itegurwa ry'amapapuro imbere y'uko ishobora gutangazwa.

Amakuru y'umugambi wawe yabitswe ntayasibwe. Koresha Vugurura ikigero c'urugendo kugira ugenzure itegurwa. Nimba umugambi ukomeza guhagarikwa, ikigero c'itunganywa ryayo n'inyandiko y'umukoresha wa seriveri bikwiye kugenzurwa.

projectWizard.uploadIncomplete: Inyishu yo gushira ntari yuzuye. Raba Imigambi yanje imbere yo gushira ukundi.

professionalProfiles.title: Umwirondoro w'umwuga
professionalProfiles.intro: Tegura ikete rya Mentor, Expert canke Trainer. Kubika inyandiko y'agateganyo ntabihindura umwirondoro wawe ukora.
professionalProfiles.developmentNote: Igerageza ry'iterambere: banza uhitore ikigo c'igikorwa hanyuma ubike inyandiko y'agateganyo, hanyuma uyikoreshe utabanje kugenzura inyandiko.
professionalProfiles.documentsNote: Gushira no gutanga inyandiko ntabirakoreshwa. Ibisabwa bishingiye ku kuntu biriho biracyakeneye isuzuma ry'ukuntu bireba; ntabishobora gufatwa nk'ibidahari ku buryo bwikora.

applicantInfo.intro: Amakuru yawe bwite yabitswe asangirwa hagati y'umicungire y'ikonti n'urugendo rwo gutangaza imigambi. Impinduka zibikwa ngaha zizoboneka igihe utseye imwe muri izi fomu. Amakuru y'ibanki n'aderesi yawe y'uburaro ni amakuru bwite y'ikonti.
applicantInfo.independence: Ubwenegihugu n'igihugu ubarizemwo ni ibintu bitandukanye.
applicantInfo.noLocalities: Nta bisobanuro vyemejwe vy'ikibanza/ikarita birashobora kuboneka kuri iyi komine. Ushobora kubika andi makuru yawe, ariko iyi aderesi ntishobora kumenyekana nk'iyuzuye gushika amakuru y'ubushakashatsi aboneka.
applicantInfo.previousAddress: Amazina y'aderesi yabitswe mbere: {address}. Ndagusavye ongera uhitore ibibanza vyemejwe; inyandiko ya kera ntahuzwa n'ibimenyetso vy'ubushakashatsi ku buryo bwikora.
applicantInfo.addressBurundi: Aderesi yo kubarizamwo / umuhanda / ayandi mabwiriza
applicantInfo.bankNote: Andika inomero y'ikonti nk'uko yatanzwe, harimwo na zeru zibanza. Kubika ntibigenzura iyo nomero kuri banki.
applicantInfo.interestsLegend: Ivyo ukunda — hitamo kimwe canke vyinshi
applicantInfo.unsaved: Ufise impinduka zitabitswe. Bika kugira uvugurure igenzura ry'ukuzura.
applicantInfo.completionNoteAccount: Iki kigero cerekana ko amakuru yawe bwite yabitswe ahuye n'ibisabwa ubu mu gutangaza imigambi.
applicantInfo.completionNoteProject: Iki ni igenzura ry'amakuru bwite gusa, atari uruhushya rwo gutangaza canke icemezo ko umugambi watangajwe.
applicantInfo.saveNote: Ushobora kubika fomu itari yuzuye hanyuma ukomeze nyuma. Impinduka zitabitswe ntazibikwa iyo usohotse kuri uyu rupapuro.

personalInfo.intro: Raba kandi uvugurure amakuru winjije igihe wategura umugambi wawe. Amakuru yabitswe asubira gukoreshwa mu migambi yawe yose.
